agent.intro.setup:
👋 Welcome to Setup! I can help you:
• Choose Quick Start or Manual setup
• Connect your Supabase project
• Run database migrations
• Troubleshoot connection issues

Tell me what you want to do or say "help me set up".
agent.intro.configuration:
👋 Welcome to Configuration! I can help you:
• Connect email accounts ({accountsCount} connected)
• Set up automation rules ({rulesCount} active)
• Configure LLM & TTS settings
• Troubleshoot connection issues

What would you like to set up?
agent.intro.drafts.one:
📧 I'm your Draft Review Assistant!

You have {count} pending draft.

I can help you:
• Summarize all drafts
• Send or dismiss specific drafts
• Preview draft content
• Review recipients and subjects

Try: "Summarize my drafts" or "Send the draft to John"
